AUTHOR: Wang, M; Xiao, W; Wang, Y; Jia, HL; Gao, Y; Chen, ZG; Zheng, FD
TITLE: SCSFish2025: a large dataset from South China sea for coral reef fish identification
REGION: Subi Reef, Nansha Islands, South China Sea
SPECIES: 30 coral reef fish species (plus generic 'fish'; blur/occlusion/angle sub-labels)
DATA: Own in-situ online monitoring system videos (23 videos, 2017) released as SCSFish2025
V_EV: Data sources: videos selected by '(1) sufficient light; (2) clearer water, less suspended matter in the water'; Discussion: 'selected videos are those with an unobstructed lens, clear water'
D2: 16 train videos (8177 frames) / 7 test videos (3779 frames); 5-fold random CV within training set
D_EV: Dataset split: 'We split the training and test sets based on the videos ... We ended up with a training set of 16 videos and a test set of 7 videos.'
R_EV: Discussion: 'the data in this dataset is only selected from a single camera view. The camera is fixed'; test = held-out videos of same camera
E_EV: Abstract: 'RT-DETRv2 achieves mAP@50 performance of 0.9960 and 0.7486 respectively on the five-fold cross-validation of the training set and the independent test set.'
METR: mAP@50, mAP@50:95, per-size and hard-sample (blur/occlusion/angle) AP, confusion matrix
NOTE: P1 applied: videos deliberately restricted to sufficient light and clear water without measurement -> V_ALL=N. V3=Y because time periods (morning/noon/evening) and light selection are reported. Video-level split within a single fixed camera; train/test videos come from March and Sept/Oct 2017 dates, but seasons are mixed across both sets, so not external. Five-fold CV within training set is random (frame-level), but headline independent test set is video-level.
